_docs.Purpose: Shared defaults applied to ALL environments. Loaded first, so appsettings.Development.json and appsettings.Production.json override these.
_docs.Put here: Only settings that are non-secret AND identical across every environment.
_docs.Logging: Baseline log levels for any environment that has no own settings file (e.g. staging).
_docs.Do NOT add: Connection strings or hostnames. Those are per-environment and loaded from appsettings.Development.json (local) or environment vars + /run/secrets (docker swarm).
